title: Broncos promote Lil’Jordan Humphrey; sign safety to practice squad

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Broncos promote Lil’Jordan Humphrey; sign safety to practice squad
sources.description: The Denver Broncos moved wide receiver Pat Bryant to short-term injured reserve, which allowed them to sign Lil’Jordan Humphrey to the active roster. They’ll need him with Bryant out, so the move makes sense. It was also reported that Bryant was likely to miss four games anyway. Overall, they did what they needed to do […]
